[b]New Features:[/b]

Added a thrilling Chainsaw Sound Effect when pulling the Besert Bydra (Big thanks to Weedcat for the idea!)
Introduced a brand-new Inventory System for better item management.
Added a Volume Slider to give you more control over your sound preferences.

[b]Fixes & Improvements:
[/b]
Resolved the Windows Scaling issue for a smoother experience.
Removed the Cryptominer for improved performance and security.
Updates now preserve your Counter progress, no longer resetting after updates.
